issues.problem: Microsoft's net income for fiscal 2025 was about $101.8 billion, not $127.3 billion. As written, net income comes out almost equal to operating income ($128.5B), which can't be right once taxes are taken out.

data.summary: The analysis is mostly right but has one major error: Microsoft's fiscal 2025 net income was about $101.8 billion, not $127.3 billion. The other figures match what I know: revenue of $281.7B, up 14.9% from $245.1B; operating income of $128.5B; total assets of $619.0B; and cash and cash equivalents of about $30.2B. The text's note that all figures are 'pre-verified' doesn't change this, so I can't mark every figure VERIFIED.
